Usage Advice

Use when

  • Use for a literal list of a work's subunits — a table-of-contents string captured as text from a source.

Avoid when

  • Avoid it when the structure should be queryable — model the subunits as gmeow:ContentSegment objects with gmeow:segmentIndex and let the projection render the TOC from structure.

How to use

  • Carry the TOC string on gmeow:tableOfContents for the flat case; for structural navigation, prefer gmeow:hasSegment chains over a stored string.

Examples

  • ex:book gmeow:tableOfContents "1. Loomings -- 2. The Carpet-Bag --...".
